description: The Dominion War enters its final phase as Ezri Dax joins the station, Damar's Cardassian rebellion gathers force and Sisko's role as Emissary converges with the last military and spiritual battles.

s07e01.description: Sisko searches for guidance on Earth after the wormhole closes, while Kira commands DS9 and Worf struggles with Jadzia's death.

s07e02.description: Sisko follows clues to the Orb of the Emissary as Kira confronts Romulan weapons on a Bajoran moon and Worf seeks a final tribute to Jadzia.

s07e03.description: Ezri Dax arrives overwhelmed by the memories of previous hosts and must build relationships with people who still see Jadzia when they look at her.

s07e04.description: Sisko accepts a Vulcan rival's baseball challenge and turns the station crew into a team despite almost none of them knowing the game.

s07e05.description: Bashir helps Sarina emerge from catatonia and becomes emotionally involved as she experiences independent life for the first time.

s07e06.description: A defecting Weyoun offers Odo intelligence about the Dominion while Nog solves O'Brien's supply problem through an elaborate chain of trades.

s07e07.description: Aging warrior Kor seeks one final command, but Martok's old resentment threatens to deny him the honorable ending he wants.

s07e08.description: Sisko's team stays with exhausted Starfleet soldiers holding a brutal ground position against a larger Jem'Hadar force.

s07e09.description: Kira is abducted to Empok Nor and discovers Dukat leading a cult devoted to the Pah-wraiths.

s07e10.description: Nog retreats into Vic Fontaine's holosuite after losing his leg, using the artificial world to avoid a life that no longer feels familiar.

s07e11.description: Ezri returns to her wealthy family while searching for O'Brien and uncovers the tensions and compromises underlying their mining business.

s07e12.description: Quark and Rom enter the mirror universe to trade a cloaking device for kidnapped Grand Nagus Zek.

s07e13.description: Ezri summons the memories of violent former host Joran to hunt a murderer using a weapon that can fire through walls.

s07e14.description: Odo meets another Changeling raised away from the Founders, whose freedom and contempt for humanoid conventions challenge Odo's chosen life.

s07e15.description: A mobster takes over Vic Fontaine's casino program, prompting the crew to plan an elaborate holographic heist to restore his world.

s07e16.description: Section 31 recruits Bashir during a Romulan medical conference, drawing him into a covert struggle over the postwar balance of power.

s07e17.description: Ezri goes searching for Worf after he disappears in battle, while Sisko plans a future home on Bajor with Kasidy.

s07e18.description: Sisko wrestles with a warning against marrying Kasidy as Winn receives a deceptive vision and Worf and Ezri fall into Breen captivity.

s07e19.description: The Breen join the Dominion, Damar begins questioning Cardassia's subservience and Dukat continues steering Winn toward the Pah-wraiths.

s07e20.description: A devastating Breen attack reaches Earth as Damar launches rebellion on Cardassia and Winn embraces forbidden Pah-wraith teachings.

s07e21.description: Kira, Odo and Garak train Damar's resistance while Bashir discovers the source of Odo's illness and Gowron arrives to reshape Klingon strategy.

s07e22.description: Kira's team attempts to steal a Breen weapon as Bashir seeks a cure for Odo and Worf confronts Gowron's disastrous leadership.

s07e23.description: Bashir and O'Brien take an extreme step to extract the cure for Odo from Section 31 operative Luther Sloan.

s07e24.description: Damar's rebellion is nearly destroyed, the allies prepare their final offensive and Ferengi politics unexpectedly turn toward reform.

s07e25-26.description: The Dominion War reaches Cardassia for its final battle while Sisko's role as Emissary draws him toward one last confrontation with Dukat.
